projectDescription: A modal terminal text editor with tree-sitter syntax highlighting and Language Server Protocol support, inspired by Vim.
keyFeatures: Modal editing (Normal, Insert, Visual, Visual-Line, Visual-Block modes) inspired by Vim
Tree-sitter syntax highlighting with on-demand grammar installation
Language Server Protocol client (diagnostics, hover, completions, code actions, goto definition)
Fuzzy file, buffer, and symbol finder
Configurable keymap, cursor shapes, and per-language indent settings via TOML
Format on save via external formatters or LSP
publicApiSurface: [[bind]] keys/action TOML table for custom keybindings
[editor] TOML table (indent_width, tab_width, use_tabs, show_whitespace, format_on_save, indent_guides, indent_guide_style, indent_animation)
[cursor] TOML table (normal, insert, visual shapes; blinking)
[languages.<name>] TOML table (extensions, grammar, comment_token, lsp, formatter, editor overrides)
